en.name: KM 215 S - Semi-Automatic End Milling Machine
en.description: Machine which works with hydro-pneumatic system, ideal for the end milling operations on PVC and aluminium profiles precisely

OPTIONAL ACCESSORIES: Milling cutter sets according to the customer profiles
Spare Mandrel&shim set for d: Ø30 mm cutters
Extention kit for d: Ø30 cutters to increas the end-milling capacity to H:180 (special)
Spare mandrel&shim set for d: Ø32 mm cutters
Extention kit for d: Ø32 cutters to increas the end-milling capacity to H:180 (special)
GENERAL FEATURES: High quality end-milling operations thanks to the hydro-pneumatic system
Adjustable support system to four different profiles
End milling of PVC mullions between 45° and 90°
Fixing the workpiece firmly thanks to the vertical and horizontal clamps
Practical cutter adjustment by means of the spacer parts
Profile clamping capacity: H:160 x W:225 mm
Maximum end-milling capacity : H:90 x W:65 mm
Maximum cutter diameter (D x d): Ø160 x Ø30 mm
